sources.detail: Owned fictional source. Original soundcheck 16:15–17:15; VIP visit 17:30–18:00; music 20:00.

sources.title: Venue operating policy · v1
sources.detail: Hard 23:00 performance/amplified-audio curfew. Approved quiet access until 00:45. Fixture policy, not universal law.

sources.title: Crew call & rest policy · v1
sources.detail: Sam and Priya have a Sunday 10:00 matinee call. At least 10 hours between calls.

sources.title: Ticket remedy policy · v1
sources.detail: Target cohort: 42 standard $35, 38 VIP $35+$15. Canceling the soundcheck perk permits a $15 original-capture refund. No captures created by this fixture.

sources.title: Flight update · final revision
sources.detail: Rolling ground hold since 12:15 Denver. At 15:10 Chicago, aircraft swap revises departure to 15:55 Denver, landing 18:55 Chicago, transfer 40 minutes.

sources.title: Lighting console self-test report
sources.detail: Controlled demonstration report at 15:25 Chicago. Department lead confirmation required; no physical equipment work claimed.
